recognize_zh: 低倍下大腸黏膜（上方隱窩）之下，黏膜下層被大量大小相近、背靠背緊密排列（back-to-back）的淋巴結節占滿，結節間只有細纖維間隔、缺少明顯套區與極性，這種結節性浸潤型態提示濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Colonic mucosa with preserved crypts overlying a dense submucosal lymphoid infiltrate
Numerous closely packed, back-to-back nodules of relatively uniform size
Nodules lack well-defined mantle zones and zonal polarization
No lymphoepithelial destruction of the overlying crypts evident at this power
describe_en: Low-power section of the colonic polyp shows intact colonic mucosa overlying a dense lymphoid proliferation that expands the submucosa. The infiltrate is composed of numerous closely packed nodules of fairly uniform size separated by thin fibrous septa, with attenuated or absent mantle zones and no obvious germinal center polarity. The mucosal crypts are preserved. The nodular architecture is suggestive of follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by cytology and immunostains (CD10, BCL6, BCL2).

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are fewer, variably sized and widely spaced with polarized germinal centers, tingible-body macrophages, intact mantles and BCL2-negative germinal centers.
MCL shows vaguely nodular or mantle-zone growth of monotonous cells without centroblasts and is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD10 negative.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL shows marginal-zone/monocytoid cells expanding between follicles with lymphoepithelial lesions and is CD10 and BCL6 negative.
